remarks: Don't miss this the timeless character of this 1174 square foot 1902 home with an elegantly combined modern addition by C+P Architects, yielding a total of 2219 square feet of living space graced with abundant natural light plus a detached two-car garage on a 7509 sf lot. Enter from the historic front porch to reveal an airy, open floor plan with a living/dining area that seamlessly connects to a well-appointed cook's kitchen that's ideal for hosting guests. Immediately to the right of entrance is one of the four bedrooms, currently used as a home office with a Murphy bed for guests and stacked laundry in the closet.
